args.evidence: raw.customer has 1575 rows but only 1500 distinct c_custkey values; 75 duplicate keys (e.g., c_custkey=16 appears twice with identical column values). stg_customers directly selects from raw.customer, so duplicates flow downstream, causing unique_stg_customers_customer_key check to fail. Duplicates are identical across all columns, indicating a double batch load, which can be resolved by deduplication in the staging model.
